name: Plug Puller, two-sided puller
author: Brennen Johnston
description: A 3D-printed tool that pulls a wall plug with your whole hand instead of a fingertip pinch, shaped to your plug and your hand. For a plug 24 mm thick or more, a USB-C tip or a round extension-cord plug: two serrated plates that zip-tie around the plug. Fill in Step 1 to Step 4; everything else is optional.
